SELECT SEQ_ISSUE.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO ISSUE ( ISSUE_ID, PROJECT_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, ISSUE_TYPE, PRIORITY, REPORTER_ID, ASSIGNEE_ID ) VALUES ( #{issueId}, #{projectId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{issueType}, #{priority}, #{reporterId}, #{assigneeId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} )
mapper.select:
SELECT I.ISSUE_ID, I.PROJECT_ID, I.TITLE, I.CONTENT, I.ISSUE_TYPE, I.PRIORITY, I.STATUS, I.REPORTER_ID, REPORTER.NAME AS REPORTER_NAME, REPORTER.LOGIN_ID AS REPORTER_LOGIN_ID, I.ASSIGNEE_ID, ASSIGNEE.NAME AS ASSIGNEE_NAME, ASSIGNEE.LOGIN_ID AS ASSIGNEE_LOGIN_ID, I.RESOLUTION, I.RESOLVED_BY, RESOLVER.NAME AS RESOLVED_BY_NAME, RESOLVER.LOGIN_ID AS RESOLVED_BY_LOGIN_ID, I.RESOLVED_AT, I.CREATED_AT, I.UPDATED_AT FROM ISSUE I INNER JOIN MEMBER REPORTER ON REPORTER.MEMBER_ID = I.REPORTER_ID LEFT JOIN MEMBER ASSIGNEE ON ASSIGNEE.MEMBER_ID = I.ASSIGNEE_ID LEFT JOIN MEMBER RESOLVER ON RESOLVER.MEMBER_ID = I.RESOLVED_BY WHERE I.PROJECT_ID = #{projectId} AND I.DELETED_AT IS NULL
ORDER BY I.CREATED_AT DESC, I.ISSUE_ID DESC OFFSET #{pageRequest.offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageRequest.size} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ISSUE I WHERE I.PROJECT_ID = #{projectId} AND I.DELETED_AT IS NULL

SELECT I.ISSUE_ID, I.PROJECT_ID, I.TITLE, I.CONTENT, I.ISSUE_TYPE, I.PRIORITY, I.STATUS, I.REPORTER_ID, REPORTER.NAME AS REPORTER_NAME, REPORTER.LOGIN_ID AS REPORTER_LOGIN_ID, I.ASSIGNEE_ID, ASSIGNEE.NAME AS ASSIGNEE_NAME, ASSIGNEE.LOGIN_ID AS ASSIGNEE_LOGIN_ID, I.RESOLUTION, I.RESOLVED_BY, RESOLVER.NAME AS RESOLVED_BY_NAME, RESOLVER.LOGIN_ID AS RESOLVED_BY_LOGIN_ID, I.RESOLVED_AT, I.CREATED_AT, I.UPDATED_AT FROM ISSUE I INNER JOIN MEMBER REPORTER ON REPORTER.MEMBER_ID = I.REPORTER_ID LEFT JOIN MEMBER ASSIGNEE ON ASSIGNEE.MEMBER_ID = I.ASSIGNEE_ID LEFT JOIN MEMBER RESOLVER ON RESOLVER.MEMBER_ID = I.RESOLVED_BY WHERE I.ISSUE_ID = #{issueId} AND I.PROJECT_ID = #{projectId} AND I.DELETED_AT IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE ISSUE SET TITLE = #{title}, CONTENT = #{content}, ISSUE_TYPE = #{issueType}, PRIORITY = #{priority}, ASSIGNEE_ID = #{assigneeId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE ISSUE_ID = #{issueId} AND PROJECT_ID = #{projectId} AND DELETED_AT IS NULL

UPDATE ISSUE SET DELETED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP, DELETED_BY = #{loginMemberId}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE ISSUE_ID = #{issueId} AND PROJECT_ID = #{projectId} AND DELETED_AT IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PROJECT_MEMBER PM INNER JOIN PROJECT P ON P.PROJECT_ID = PM.PROJECT_ID WHERE PM.PROJECT_ID = ISSUE.PROJECT_ID AND PM.MEMBER_ID = #{loginMemberId} AND P.DELETED_AT IS NULL AND (ISSUE.REPORTER_ID = #{loginMemberId} OR PM.ROLE = 'ADMIN') )
